Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

twfeweights 1.0.0

First CRAN release.

Functionality

  • Staggered adoption without covariates: twfe_weights() recovers the weights that a TWFE regression places on each group-time average treatment effect, ATT(g,t), from the output of did::att_gt(). attO_weights() and att_simple_weights() give the weights behind the overall ATT^o and ATT^simple of Callaway and Sant’Anna (2021). All three support sampling weights, gaps between periods, and panels observed in only some periods.
  • Covariates, two periods: two_period_reg_weights() and two_period_aipw_weights() write a TWFE regression and AIPW, regression adjustment or inverse probability weighting as reweighting estimators and report covariate balance, following Caetano and Callaway (2024).
  • Covariates, staggered adoption: implicit_twfe_weights() and implicit_aipw_weights() decompose the estimate into weighted group-time comparisons; twfe_cov_bal() and aipw_cov_bal() add balance statistics, with summary() and ggtwfeweights() methods.
  • Balance statistics that can be applied to any weights: pooled_sd(), log_ratio_sd(), frac_treated_extreme() and effective_sample_size().

Changes since the GitHub development version

  • The package is now licensed under GPL-3 (previously MIT).
  • Removed the unfinished did_post_lasso() and the unused post_lasso argument of two_period_aipw_weights().
  • Internal helpers are no longer exported: gt_weights(), mp_weights_obj(), two_period_covs_obj(), mp_covariate_bal_summary_helper(), combine_twfe_weights_gt(), twfe_cov_bal_gt() and aipw_cov_bal_gt().
  • Fewer dependencies: dplyr, tidyr, magrittr, rlang and DRDID are no longer required. caret is now required (rather than suggested), because implicit_twfe_weights() needs it through BMisc.
  • fix: implicit_twfe_weights() works without covariates (xformula = ~1 or NULL). Previously this crashed R. Without covariates its weights now match twfe_weights().
  • fix: the number of post-treatment periods is now the number of observed periods at or after g, not max(t) - g + 1. Weights were wrong when periods were skipped.
  • twfe_weights(), attO_weights() and att_simple_weights() now return their results visibly, so they print when called at the console.
  • two_period_reg_weights()$est is now an unnamed number.
  • Clearer error and warning messages, which name the function, the requirement and an alternative where there is one.
  • New vignettes: vignette("twfe-weights") and vignette("covariate-balance"). Every exported function now has examples, and the documentation describes what each function computes and returns.
